newsitem.title: CHINA: China northeast ships 6.25 mln T grain to south.
newsitem.headline: China northeast ships 6.25 mln T grain to south.

text.p: China's main grain-growing regions in the northeast had shipped 6.25 million tonnes of grain to the south by April 20, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Thursday.
The provinces of Heilongjiang, Jilin and Liaoning and the Inner Mongolia region had sent the grain in three shipments to major markets in large and medium-sized cities, the newspaper said.
It said procurement and shipping of the grain was basically smooth and prices were relatively stable, but gave no further details.
China reaped a bumper harvest of 490 million tonnes of grain in 1996, up from the previous year's record 466 million tonnes, official figures show.
China's northeastern provinces shipped two million tonnes of corn to southern provinces in late 1996 and a further 1.5 million tonnes early this year.
A third batch of 3.0 million tonnes was now being moved to ease shortages in the south and reduce overstocked warehouses in the north, state media has said.
